import bpy,json,hashlib,struct
from mathutils import Vector
ns=bpy.app.driver_namespace['terminal_craft'];c=bpy.data.collections['Harbor_Arrival_Landing'];original=bpy.data.collections['Pier_Working'];report=[]
for o in c.objects:
 source=bpy.data.objects[o['source_component']]
 same_uv=(len(o.data.loops)==len(source.data.loops) and all((a.uv-b.uv).length<1e-8 for a,b in zip(o.data.uv_layers[0].data,source.data.uv_layers[0].data)))
 same_verts=(len(o.data.vertices)==len(source.data.vertices) and all((a.co-b.co).length<1e-8 for a,b in zip(o.data.vertices,source.data.vertices)))
 same_materials=[m.name for m in o.data.materials]==[m.name for m in source.data.materials]
 report.append({'component':o.name,'source':source.name,'same_uv':same_uv,'same_mesh':same_verts,'same_materials':same_materials,'underwater_pile_extension':source.name.startswith('WaterPile')})
assert all(x['same_materials'] and ((x['same_mesh'] and x['same_uv']) or x['underwater_pile_extension']) for x in report)
path=ns['root']/'captures/terminal_navy_arrival_review_20261110/original_component_audit.json';path.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
print('ORIGINAL_COMPONENTS',len(report),'UNCHANGED_UV_AND_MESH',sum(x['same_uv'] and x['same_mesh'] for x in report),'PILES_EXTENDED',sum(x['underwater_pile_extension'] for x in report))
print('CURRENT_FILE',bpy.data.filepath)
